availability_boundary: 山形市発展計画2030は2025年度開始で、成果指標は更新される。基準値・目標値・年度実績・更新日を別項目で保持し、旧発展計画2025の値を現行系列へ無検証で接続しない。
quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies the current 2025-2029 development plan/local strategy, indicator route, FY2026 budget route, and FY2024 settlement/major-measures route. It does not promote indicator values, reported outcomes, or fiscal values to Reviewed and does not infer achievement, causality, or cross-city comparability.
